'''Aquato Boliscon''' was a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who invested the profits he made running guns and [[Spice/Legends|spice]] into buying [[Soco-Jarel Spaceport]] on [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]]. Aquato operated [[Boliscon Towers]], twin five-storey docking hangars on the edge of the spaceport. Boliscon was renowned for his expertise in finding and acquiring quality [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and reselling them for a profit.<ref name="BSS" />
